title: The capabilities probe exposes the launcher's update check so the upgrade banner can appear

criteria.given: the launcher's TelemetryService learned of a newer release (or the acceptance harness boots with SAIKU_TELEMETRY=off, so no check has run)
criteria.then: GET /rest/saiku/info/capabilities carries an update section whose available flag and latestVersion report exactly what the check found — nothing (available:false, latestVersion:null) when the check has not run, failed or is opted out

steps.name: capabilities exposes the update-check surface, reporting nothing when no check has run

update.because: the update check rides on the capabilities probe the SPA already loads

update.available.because: the acceptance harness boots with SAIKU_TELEMETRY=off, so the launcher's check never ran and no newer-version claim may be made

update.latestVersion.because: no version number without a check result
